title: Cleaning contract ended without notice
description: Kingsgate ended our three-year office cleaning contract with one week's email notice on 25 October 2025, effective 1 November 2025. The contract requires three months' notice. We lost three months of fees at £9,800 a month and had to keep staff on during that period because of their notice entitlements. Our solicitor-style letter before claim got a reply denying liability.
notes: The most complete case: all six elements should have evidence.
